   "Datacenter projects already under construction support strong spending growth through 2027 (86 GW) and underpin just above half of GIR's 2028 spending forecasts. Visibility is more limited beyond 2028, and the 2029-2030 outlook depends on announced projects converting to construction.",
   "States where Democrats are likely to further restrict data center development account for roughly 45% of planned US data center capacity. Texas alone accounts for roughly 25%.",
   "GIR sees a potential restriction outcome as smoothing spending and extending the duration of the cycle, rather than reducing the total addressable market (TAM).",
   "Current project timelines imply ~55 GW of capacity energizing in 2028, out of 86 GW under construction now. High probability announcements add 171 GW and medium/low probability announcements add 293 GW.",

Hyperscaler capex is $829bn in 2026, an estimated $1.2 trillion in 2027 and $1.4 trillion in 2028.",
   "Gina Hinojosa (D) won the Texas governor race against Greg Abbott (R).    "US Senate (12 Nov-20 Dec) will consider the Ratepayer Protection Act and transmission permitting reform. Lame-duck passage starts a 12-month statutory clock for utilities to implement dedicated high-load tariffs, shifting grid upgrade capex onto hyperscalers.",
